svg.title: Two subclasses of Robot
svg.desc: A UML class diagram. Tag 1, at the top: the class Robot with plus battery: int; plus DRAIN_PCT_PER_MIN = 2, underlined; plus perform_task(task, minutes): bool; plus from_dict(config): Robot, underlined. Below it, two classes, each with a line up to a hollow triangle at Robot's bottom edge. Tag 2: Scout with plus DRAIN_PCT_PER_MIN = 1, underlined; plus max_speed_mps: float; plus drive_time(distance_m): float. Tag 3: Hauler with plus DRAIN_PCT_PER_MIN = 3, underlined; plus payload_kg: float; plus __str__(): str.
